highlights: Active-apps overview with parallel preview capture, integrated search and command shortcuts.
Multi-GPU metrics, disk telemetry and richer dashboard visualisations.
AI Copilot discovers provider credentials and reports live activity.

sections.title: Overview
items: Batch window previews are captured in parallel, keeping the overview responsive at 240 Hz.
The overview accepts '>wallpaper' and command shortcuts with a smooth focus transition.

sections.title: Dashboard
items: GPU and disk telemetry joined the performance tab.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Active/running app regressions in the dock and taskbar.
Idle decay after an AI turn completes.
